A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the parameterized polyhedron approach is a very useful tool for explicit MPC.
a polyhedral representation for the feasible domain is used in order to define a polyhedral decomposition of the parameters space.
we have developed an efficient and robust algorithm for the generation of the parameterized polyhedron and the corresponding explicit predictive controller.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed approach can be used in the context of constrained model-based predictive control for systems with multiple input and output constraints, and that the computational complexity of the on-line optimization can be significantly reduced.
